foy.definition:
n. Faith; allegiance; fealty.
n. A feast given by one about to leave a place.

foyer.definition: n a large entrance or reception room or area
foyer.translation: n. 门厅, 入门大堂

foyers.definition: n. a large entrance or reception room or area
foyers.translation: n. <法>（剧场等的）门厅( foyer的复数形式 ); 休息室; （私宅或公寓的）前厅

foys.definition:
plural of foy
n. Faith; allegiance; fealty.
